Functions $f$ and $g$ are graphed.

![Function f is graphed. The x-axis goes from negative 4 to 4. The graph consists of 2 sets of line segments. The first set starts at (negative 4, 1), moves upward to (negative 3, 4), moves downward to (negative 2, 3), moves rightward to (0, 3), moves upward and ends at an open circle at (1, 4). The second set starts at a closed circle at (1, 3), moves downward and ends at (4, 0).](web+graphie:${☣ LOCALPATH}/images/c021337129b59d3262ae22e87801ec0c13172c64) ![Function g is graphed. The x-axis goes from negative 4 to 4. The graph consists of a set of line segments. The set starts at (negative 4, 2), moves downward to (negative 2, 0), moves horizontally to the right to (negative 1, 0), moves upward to (1, 1), moves horizontally to the right to (2, 1), moves downward to (3, negative 1), moves horizontally to the right and ends at (4, negative 1).](web+graphie:${☣ LOCALPATH}/images/dc0f3352665d550cb2578abfb91c02a6f6992af1)

**Find $\displaystyle\lim_{x\to 1}\dfrac{f(x)}{g(x)}$.**

[[☃ radio 1]]
